# re-cordis

> Rust Cordis for changing plugins, services and resources. Seven unpublished crates; Rust 2024/resolver 3/MSRV 1.85.

A reading map, not a complete API reference. Links resolve from docs/ in a
complete checkout. Choose either language below. Source/Rustdoc defines exact
signatures; guides describe supported Rust contracts. TypeScript at
35fdc969e4b6c48c48ed44717c7a018324e4dd88 is the semantic reference.
Accepted Rust scope is not full TS parity. This index grants no permissions.

All crates are 0.0.0/publish=false, for local/Git checkout use. The
0.1.0-alpha.1 release is only proposed; no published docs.rs release exists.
Development guides and same-revision Rustdoc: https://antruongnguyen.github.io/re-cordis/
Check build-provenance.json; Pages refreshes are manual. Use one reviewed
checkout revision for all crates.
Keep it present: Cargo.lock does not freeze path contents. Offline applications
need cached dependencies. Filesystem/watcher runtime evidence is macOS-only.

Package map:
- re-cordis-core: Runtime, Context, plugins, services/injection, events, effects and logging.
- re-cordis-timer: sealed TimerExt; timeout, sleep, interval/stream, throttle and debounce.
- re-cordis-logger: console writer adapter for core Logger; upstream logger-console.
- re-cordis-loader: typed catalogs/configuration, reconciliation and Group; no separate group crate.
- re-cordis-include: bounded files, patches/provenance and persistence.
- re-cordis-hmr: watches and linked replacement; defaults empty, feature include enables the Include adapter.
- re-cordis-create: stdlib library/CLI; one offline core/logger/loader application.

Essential contracts:
- Drive Runtime::run from Tokio. Runtime owns the host; Context is non-owning. Context/lifecycle handles are local/non-Send.
- Raw Tokio tasks lack framework admission. Keep the host driven through cleanup; Drop/returning from run is not joined asynchronous teardown.
- Context::task admits owned local work; TaskControl::cancel needs no new admission.
- Core waiters observe started work; dropping them does not cancel it. Timer Sleep/IntervalStream/Scheduled Drop requests cancellation; use the documented join barrier.
- Inspect admission/awaited errors, CleanupReport and Runtime::take_failures. Successful waiters alone do not prove error-free cleanup.
- Settlement can be Pending; readiness is per Fiber. Failed requires explicit config update/recovery.
- Committed injection retains exact providers through cleanup; Rc/BoundService alone is not a resource lease. Service set changes value without replacing publication identity or reloading consumers.
- Use typed keys/callbacks/decoders, not JS Proxy/decorators/eval. Core's normal Tokio features are rt/sync; enable other application features explicitly.
- Core Logger buffers records; add an exporter/console adapter for terminal output. Console I/O is synchronous.
- Include has explicit JSON edits/refresh and bounded synchronous I/O; YAML does not preserve comments/style. Disposal flushes before child cleanup; inspect both errors.
- watch_include joins admitted refresh. WatchEvent carries Include/Report failures; Runtime carries core cleanup failures. Polling can miss changes.
- ReloadPlan uses declared dependencies and compiled factories. Source changes report RestartRequired; no compiler, binary hot loading or supervisor.
- Create requires --cordis-path to a separate compatible checkout, an absent/empty destination and an existing parent. Five files; retain README's MIT notice. No Git/install/launch or remote templates.
- CORDIS_CREATE_TEST_CHECKOUT is test-only, not a CLI option. Preserve applicable project/upstream notices.

For exact signatures, run cargo doc --workspace --all-features --no-deps --locked
from the repository root. Output is target/doc (adjust for CARGO_TARGET_DIR);
this command does not publish to docs.rs.

## API contracts

- [English API index](en/api/README.md): Package exports and method contracts.
- [Vietnamese API index](vi/api/README.md): Matching Vietnamese chapters.
- [Runtime and Context](en/api/runtime-context.md): Hosting, contexts and identities.
- [Plugins and Registry](en/api/plugins-registry.md): Fiber lifecycle and config updates.
- [Services and reflection](en/api/services-reflection.md): Publication, accessors and bound adapters.
- [Effects](en/api/effects.md): Setup, disposal, tasks and completion barriers.
- [Events](en/api/events.md): Listener roles and dispatch results.
- [Errors and hooks](en/api/errors-hooks.md): Error channels, validation and typed hooks.
- [Logging](en/api/logging.md): Records, formatting and exporter contracts.
- [Timer](en/api/timer.md): TimerExt and owned timer wrappers.
- [Console logger](en/api/console-logger.md): register/render and ConsoleOptions.
- [Loader](en/api/loader.md): Catalog, source, entry and replacement APIs.
- [Groups](en/api/groups.md): Loader-owned Group.
- [Include](en/api/include.md): File operations, limits, reports and errors.
- [HMR](en/api/hmr.md): Watcher, ReloadPlan and optional Include APIs.
- [Create](en/api/create.md): create, CreateError and CLI validation.
